After the resurrection he was taken up into heaven, and after a hundred days we were gathered together to celebrate the heavenly worship. This is our faith, we believe, professed during the Eucharist. This solemnity of the Ascension of our Lord gives us a message that his mission has been fulfilled in the Father's will, which he returns to us as a mission. In returning to the Father, Jesus was given a new life and a mission to go forth with him into the world. He is the Son of God, who came down from heaven to earth and made himself known through the Holy Spirit, and we are called to be his disciples in this way. The assumption was a mystery that Jesus had not fully understood. It is a mystery that he cannot understand completely. There is a difference between Christ's assumed and God's Second Person in the Holy Trinity become man. He is both fully God and fully man, a mystery as great as we cannot understand. It is a complete mystery of our faith. The assumption was made by Jesus, who is the Son of God, but he did not possess it. This is why he became man.
